absence_adjudications.decision_rule: A county may be labeled eligible_verified_no_known_project only when all seven required domains are documented as reviewed_no_qualifying_evidence through the dataset as-of date, the review is final, and no governed positive-exposure finding applies. Partial reviews remain unresolved; positive evidence must also be recorded in the exposure-findings register.

interpretation_limits: A high match score means economic similarity under this specification; it does not verify absence of an unrecorded data center.

Three national inventories plus candidate-specific positive findings reduce false negatives but do not prove absence, so every surviving candidate still requires local facility-absence research before analytical use.
The available national panel does not yet include industry mix, urban-rural classification, electricity-market structure, tax policy, water conditions, or major concurrent investments.
These are descriptive comparison candidates, not causal estimates or finalized donor pools.

method.baseline_rule: Use five years before the earliest documented study-project anchor when available; otherwise use the labeled 2001–2005 structural window.
method.candidate_pool: Counties outside the 35-host cohort with zero linked records in the repository active-facility inventory and two pinned external national registries, no governed candidate-specific positive exposure finding, and complete baseline features.
method.distance: Square root of the weighted sum of squared feature differences standardized by candidate-pool interquartile ranges, plus disclosed Census-geography penalties.
method.score: 100 / (1 + standardized distance). Scores rank candidates within a host specification and are not probabilities.

positive_exposure_findings.interpretation_note: These findings are conservative contamination exclusions only. They do not add facilities or projects to the active study inventory and do not imply that public or institutional facilities are comparable to hyperscale projects.
positive_exposure_findings.qualifying_rule: Exclude a county when a credible source documents a dedicated data-center facility, colocation operation, separately identified institutional data-center building, formal proposal, pre-application, or site-specific developer approach in that county. Ordinary server rooms, accessory IT closets, headquarters without a documented facility, generic policy debate, and facilities merely serving the county from another county do not qualify.

scope: Identify economically comparable counties for each of the 35 active-project host counties using counties with zero known data-center facility or project records across the repository inventory, two pinned external national registries, and governed candidate-specific positive-exposure findings.
